title: Image of a polynomial basic open under the coefficient projection
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $f=\sum_{i\geq0}a_iT^i\in R[T]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring], and $\mathfrak p\in\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Put $D(f)=\{\mathfrak q\in\operatorname{Spec}R[T]:f\notin\mathfrak q\}$, and let $\pi:\operatorname{Spec}R[T]\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ send a prime to its inverse image under the coefficient inclusion $R\to R[T]$. Then $\mathfrak p\in\pi(D(f))$ if and only if $a_i\notin\mathfrak p$ for some $i\geq0$.

source.place: Tag 00FB, lemma-affineline-open, proof, last sentence: image of D(f) is the union of the principal opens of its coefficients.
